title: A Modular Framework to Predict Alzheimer’s Disease Progression Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
reviewer_notes: Recursive visit-conditioned generation is shown, but no patient split, matched future-image error, uncertainty, external validation, or clinical comparison is reported.

title: AKI-twinX: explainable organ structured digital twin for sepsis AKI trajectory forecasting
evidence_anchors: Figs. 2-5; Methods Phase 1/2 and external validation; Discussion counterfactual limitations
reviewer_notes: Strong next-window and external discrimination evidence; withdrawal is an altered-input forecast, not a causally identified effect. Main text is inconsistent about 12- versus 24-hour horizon.

title: CellPace: A temporal diffusion-forcing framework for simulation, interpolation and forecasting of single-cell dynamics
evidence_anchors: Fig. 1; Figs. 2-5; Methods temporal splits/generation/metrics; Software and Data Availability
reviewer_notes: Leakage-controlled held-out-stage interpolation/extrapolation and free-running sliding windows are strong; cross-sectional cells, no frozen transfer, and no formal calibration limit interpretation.

title: Deep Generative Model of Macrophage Immune Response for Hepato-intestinal Tumor Therapy Optimization.
evidence_anchors: Figs. 1-4; Tables 3-4 and S11-S16; temporal/external holdouts; deployment and limitations sections
reviewer_notes: Planning and real observational decision use are reported, but allocation was nonrandomized and the paper disclaims causal identification. Public code/checkpoint claims lack a stable inspectable repository link.

title: Digital twin models for predicting venetoclax and azacitidine-induced neutropenia in patients with acute myeloid leukemia.
evidence_anchors: Fig. 1; Fig. 3/Table 2; Methods multi-cycle learning; Data/Code availability
reviewer_notes: Patient-specific temporal tests and long-term ODE rollouts support dynamics evidence; no external cohort or calibrated predictive uncertainty, and the seven-cycle subset is selected.

title: Learning Temporal Basis Vectors for Closed-Loop Neural Stimulation.
evidence_anchors: Corresponding arXiv manuscript forecasting results and two closed-loop simulation experiments
reviewer_notes: Action-conditioned forecasting and simulated control are operational, but evidence comes from sessions in only two animals; no external subject test or probabilistic calibration.

title: Multi-Objective Model-based Reinforcement Learning for Infectious Disease Control
evidence_anchors: Secs. 3-5; Figs. 3-6; Algorithms 1-3; Appendix C city holdout
reviewer_notes: Long-horizon posterior policy rollouts, no-action comparisons, and explicit regime-value objectives are present; causal policy effects rely on a six-city observational transition model.

title: Predictive modeling of hemodynamics during viscerosensory neurostimulation via neural computation mechanism in the brainstem.
evidence_anchors: Figs. 6-7; Methods H-BIND, k-fold validation, NMPC; Data/Code availability
reviewer_notes: Real stimulation-response trajectories support individualized dynamics; closed-loop utility and unstable-target checks are in-silico only, with no external animal or human validation.

title: Structure-aware World Model for Probe Guidance via Large-scale Self-supervised Pre-train
reviewer_notes: Large person-disjoint held-out scan evaluation supports offline guidance utility, but transition fidelity is only a downstream proxy and there is no rollout, uncertainty, external site, code, or data release.

title: Type 1 diabetes prevention clinical trial simulator: Case reports of model-informed drug development tool.
evidence_anchors: Clinical Trial Design/Power Curve; Case Studies I-II and Figs. 2-4; Conclusion
reviewer_notes: The public simulator performs placebo-versus-assumed-effect trial rollouts and go/no-go design analyses, but effects are user imposed, not estimated or causally validated; current simulator validation is absent.
